flow_ref: User story (not in the flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi: framework/workflows/notification_sms_email/{jobs/NotificationSmsEmailJob,helpers/NotificationSmsEmailHelper} (reminder query for stage DR3, DataHive contact refresh, exclusion list, SMS/email), framework/workflows/furnish_processing/helpers/FurnishApprovalHelper (driver becomes offender at DN1), agencies/toppan/upload/models/ToppanStage (DN1 -> DN2 -> DR3), cron-schedules-prod.properties. ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminui, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: not used for this feature
note: Status in stories.json: Demo paid (50% of 75%), 1 point. Demo remark: Vault and code split, the Vault connection is granted to the api App Service. This is the twin of OCMS11.51 for the driver's 3rd letter (stage DR3): the same reminder query includes DR3, and all four steps get the same fit as OCMS11.51. Same blockers: cron.notification.enabled=false (cron-schedules-prod.properties:236), DataHive refresh off (:48), company emails at DN1/DN2/DR3 skipped (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:311-317). DR3 is the last stage before CPC (ToppanStage.java:24), so this e-reminder is the last warning; the ENOTEDAYS/POS/PDD parameters for DR3 in the DB: cannot verify from repo. Vault, DOS and permissions: cannot verify from repo. Ticket used: OCMS-DF-2026-180. The stale copy ocmsadminprivateapi/cronservice/ was not used as evidence.
recommendation: Claim partially, same as OCMS11.51: the e-reminder logic for stage DR3 exists, but the eNotification job and the contact refresh are off in prod and company-driver emails at the DN/DR stages are skipped. Ask URA to confirm the prod configuration

steps.step: A driver notice that already received the 3rd letter (stage DR3) is picked for the e-reminder check shortly before it falls due
steps.detail: queryRecordsForReminder selects notices with last_processing_stage IN (RD1,RD2,RR3,DN1,DN2,DR3) (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1114) and offender_indicator = 'Y', so the current offender is picked, which is the driver after furnish (:1112; FurnishApprovalHelper.java:555 and :652 make the driver the offender at stage DN1); the due date (last_processing_date + POS + PDD) must fall inside the ENOTEDAYS window (:1105-1120). Called from NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:162. The driver path DN1 -> DN2 -> DR3 is in ToppanStage.java:22-24. Sebagian because (1) the same query serves owner, hirer and driver, there is no driver-specific filter; (2) cron.notification.enabled=false in cron-schedules-prod.properties:236 (also UAT and dev), so the job does not run per the repo configuration; (3) the JOIN to ocms_parameter ENOTEDAYS per stage is an inner join, so if the parameter row for DR3 is missing the notice is never selected; the parameter value in the DB: cannot verify from repo. Ticket OCMS-DF-2026-180 (eNotification, Closed) says it is waiting for the eNotification cron to be activated.

steps.step: OCMS checks the driver's latest mobile number/email (Epic OCMS9) before the e-reminder is built
steps.detail: The job calls batchPreloadContactInfo and refreshContactInfo for every record (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:185-188). refreshContactInfo only queries DataHive (Singpass for individuals, CorpPass for companies) when cron.enareminder.datahive = 'true' (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:92-93, :2461-2485); the value is false in cron-schedules-prod.properties:48 (also UAT and dev), so the number used is the one stored in ocms_offence_notice_owner_driver, i.e. the number from the furnish form (FurnishApprovalHelper.java:551-558) or an earlier lookup. The pre-reminder check exists in code but is off per the properties. Whether DataHive = DOS in the story, the view contents and the Vault connection: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: A driver who opted out, holds a passport or has no valid mobile/email gets no e-reminder, and the letter track continues
steps.detail: The reminder query drops id_no values in ocms_enotification_exclusion_list (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1133) and the job checks the exclusion list and the passport ID type again before the SMS batch is built (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:225-245): for reminder stages the record is only skipped and the notice stage is untouched, so the next letter still proceeds. A record with no phoneNo (individual) or no email (company), or with a contactError, is skipped through validateContactInfo (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:252-266; NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2259-2290). The logic matches the story; note that the job running it is off in prod (step 1).

steps.step: An individual driver gets an SMS and a company driver gets an email as the e-reminder
steps.detail: determineDeliveryChannel returns SMS for every ID type except B and email for type B (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:443-452; NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:269-272 and :353-354). The individual SMS path is not split per stage, so DR3 is included. But for stages DN1/DN2/DR3 the email build is skipped with the comment company email templates not available (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:311-317), so a company driver gets no email at stage DR3 even with a valid contact. The DB SMS template (DR3_SMS_INDIVIDUAL) is not in the repo: cannot verify from repo.
